narrative.issue_register_md: 8 formal issues tracked across the assessment, with 1 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH, and 7 MEDIUM/LOW severity. Critical issues apply score caps per governance rule; HIGH and MEDIUM issues inform prioritization without capping.

per_pillar_md.P1: OneDigital's position relative to peers is uneven by design: above peer in 9 of 17 categories, at parity in 4, and below peer in 4. The concentration of above-peer strengths in P1 (culture, innovation, ESG) and P3 (compliance, resilience) combined with a -1.13 gap creates a distinctive pattern — OneDigital leads on organizational and regulatory dimensions but trails on platform security.

Digital Marketing & Acquisition — Campaign automation, segmentation, digital acquisition channels
